stories.title: Sources: Commanders' Tunsil suffers torn triceps
stories.summary: Washington Commanders left tackle Laremy Tunsil suffered a torn triceps in practice, will likely require surgery and will miss at least a significant portion of the regular season, a source told NFL Network's Mike Garafolo and Steve Wyche on Saturday.

stories.title: Cunningham calls Carrington's foul 'unnecessary'
stories.summary: The Sky's DiJonai Carrington was assessed a flagrant 2 and ejected Saturday after a hard foul across the face and neck area of Fever guard Sophie Cunningham.

stories.title: WNBA quickly rescinds Clark's 8th tech; no ban
stories.summary: The WNBA rescinded a technical foul against Caitlin Clark on Saturday, less than two hours after she received what would have been her eighth of the season.

stories.title: Dodgers snap 7-game skid, edge Diamondbacks
stories.summary: It took 10 innings, but the Los Angeles Dodgers snapped a seven-game losing streak by outlasting the Arizona Diamondbacks 2-1 on Saturday night at Chase Field.

stories.title: Brees, Fitzgerald, Kuechly enter Hall of Fame
stories.summary: Drew Brees, Larry Fitzgerald and Luke Kuechly were among those inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame on Saturday.
